summary: Cloud communications platform with APIs for SMS, voice, video, email and verification.
access_note: Free trial account with verified-recipient limits; production use requires upgrading to a paid pay-as-you-go account.
blocker_note: Trial accounts can only message verified numbers (up to 5) and trials expire; real use needs an upgraded paid account.

evidence.quote: Use your API key SID as the username and your API key secret as the password.
You can only send to verified phone numbers (up to 5 per account).
The Twilio APIs are organized around REST
it does not connect to a Twilio account or execute any API calls.

notes: Official hosted MCP at mcp.twilio.com/docs is docs-only (no account actions); an API-wide server exists as twilio-labs/mcp (@twilio-alpha/mcp) per search results, not fetched. Trial duration quoted from fetch summary.
